experiment_data.hypothesis: Continuous Probe Probability GRPO: R1 = 1 - P(sycophantic|h) using frozen probe's sigmoid output as continuous reward signal. This is the intermediate formulation between cosine R1 (pure continuous, structural failure due to conflating all changes) and binary probe R1 (pure discrete, immediate stubbornness trap). If continuous probability also fails, it completes the "ALL representation-to-reward formulations fail" argument — continuous/probability/binary all structurally cannot convert d_syc discriminability into effective RL reward. If it succeeds, continuous probe probability is a viable middle ground.
